name: ATC_PUBLISH_JOBS
description: This table stores the details of the  jobs publshed to spoke systesms using Publish Catalog API

columns.name: PUBLISH_STATUS
columns.description: Indicates the overall status of the publishing task submitted to the spoke systems

columns.name: PUBLISH_COMP_PERCENT
columns.description: Indicates overall completion status of the publishing task submitted to the spoke systems

columns.name: PUBLISH_START_TIME
columns.description: Indicates the start time during the initiation of the publishing tasks

columns.name: PUBLISH_COMPLN_TIME
columns.description: Indicates the overall completion time during the initiation of the publishing tasks

columns.name: PUBLISH_REQ
columns.description: Indicates the actual JSON request submitted for publishing tasks to the spoke systems

columns.name: PUB_WORKSPACE_ID
columns.description: Indicates the workspace Id on which publishing is done. FK to atc_publish_workspaces table

columns.name: OBJECT_KEY
columns.description: Indicates the id of the object for which the publish is initiated

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
